nodes.label: SVG Mask Cutout
nodes.rationale: CSS mask with white reveal and black hide fills in luminance mode; objectBoundingBox scales from 0 to 1 along the element; an organic Bezier path defines the artistic paint-splat shape.

nodes.label: Adjacent Element Mask Layout
nodes.rationale: Text stays in a safe unmasked card-body; the decorative card-accent div next to it carries the custom SVG mask so text remains readable; matching backgrounds make the parts visually merge.

nodes.label: Pure CSS Gradient Cutout
nodes.rationale: Simple geometric cutouts via a radial-gradient or linear-gradient inside mask-image directly; extra top padding clears the notch.

nodes.label: Mask Fallback Strategy
nodes.rationale: Without mask-image support the element degrades to a normal rectangular element; text layers stay outside the mask so content remains readable.

nodes.label: CSS Mask Soft Edge
nodes.rationale: mask-image with a linear gradient fades the content itself, so the background shows through without text-selection or pointer-event interference.

nodes.label: Dual Edge Fade
nodes.rationale: One gradient with color stops fades both the top and bottom edges of a container.

nodes.label: Overlay Fade Fallback
nodes.rationale: A @supports-based fallback with a semi-transparent ::after overlay when masking is unsupported; pointer-events: none lets the text underneath stay interactive.

nodes.label: Relative Text Sizing
nodes.rationale: Unitless line-height, no px font-size (prefer rem), overflow-wrap: break-word for long URLs; WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing safe.

nodes.label: Readable Line Length
nodes.rationale: Paragraphs capped at ~80 characters; no text-align: justify (hyphens: auto if used); no fixed heights on text elements.

nodes.label: Text Wrapping Rules
nodes.rationale: text-wrap: balance for headlines, text-wrap: pretty for body text; avoid on visible-box elements.

nodes.label: Responsive Typography clamp()
nodes.rationale: Combine viewport and font-relative units in clamp() with the maximum no more than 2.5 times the minimum so browser zoom still resizes text up to 200%.

nodes.label: Layered Drop Shadows
nodes.rationale: Multiple shadows for soft depth; filter: drop-shadow for non-rectangular shapes or transparent PNGs.

nodes.label: Gradient Color Space
nodes.rationale: in oklab by default for color-mix() and gradients; oklch for chromatic saturation; cartesian oklab avoids hue-angle tint shifts.

nodes.label: CSS Gradient Patterns
nodes.rationale: Stripes, checkerboard, polka dot and pie chart patterns built from gradient plus hard stops and repeating gradients.

nodes.label: CSS Blend Modes
nodes.rationale: mix-blend-mode and background-blend-mode for lighting overlays, scoped with isolation: isolate.

nodes.label: Font-size-adjust
nodes.rationale: Normalises fallback text size on the primary font metric (x-height default); from-font keyword or manual value; cap-height and ch-width alternatives.

nodes.label: Fallback Mitigation
nodes.rationale: @font-face size-adjust, ascent-override and descent-override descriptors tune fallback fonts manually.

nodes.label: font-size-adjust for Mixed Fonts
nodes.rationale: Applies font-size-adjust to elements mixing font families, such as inline code or themed font switches.

nodes.label: Numeric Aspect-Ratio Override
nodes.rationale: Specific numeric values (e.g. 0.5) when the reference font proportions differ across themes.

nodes.label: Non-Supporting Browsers Fallback
nodes.rationale: @supports not (font-size-adjust: from-font) block with manual line-height and font-size overrides.

nodes.label: CSS Mask Textures
nodes.rationale: mask-image with url('grunge-pattern.png') plus mask-repeat and mask-size for realistic weathering textures.

nodes.label: CSS Gradient Checkerboard Texture
nodes.rationale: Self-contained checkerboard from linear-gradient hard stops; mask-position sets a two-row tile.

nodes.label: Mask Mode Behavior
nodes.rationale: match-source: luminance for inline SVG mask elements, alpha for image files and CSS gradients.

nodes.label: Background Overlay Fallback
nodes.rationale: @supports fallback adds a background image texture without affecting content transparency.

nodes.label: Emscripten Modular Flags
nodes.rationale: -sSTRICT, -sEXPORT_ES6, -sENVIRONMENT=web/worker, -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH, -Werror -Wall, -O3/-Os/-Oz with -flto; redundant default flags are omitted.

nodes.label: Boundary-Efficient Entry Points
nodes.rationale: Process whole buffers in a single call; read and write the contiguous buffer in linear memory (HEAPU8); re-read HEAPU8 fresh after growth.

nodes.label: Non-Blocking WebAssembly Calls
nodes.rationale: Run heavy Wasm in a Web Worker, use -pthread with SharedArrayBuffer, or yield via emscripten_set_main_loop, -sJSPI or -sASYNCIFY.

nodes.label: Development Flags
nodes.rationale: -sASSERTIONS and -g variants; watch stack overflow in recursive code with -sSTACK_SIZE.

nodes.label: Static Linking Guidance
nodes.rationale: Prefer static linking and static archives; avoid dynamic linking (-sMAIN_MODULE/-sSIDE_MODULE) unless required.

nodes.label: Declarative WebMCP Forms
nodes.rationale: toolname, tooldescription, toolautosubmit and toolparamdescription attributes on form elements; the browser synthesises the JSON Schema from the form controls.

nodes.label: Form Submission Agent Events
nodes.rationale: SubmitEvent carries agentInvoked and respondWith(promise) for agent-submitted forms.

nodes.label: Agent Lifecycle Pseudo-classes
nodes.rationale: :tool-form-active and :tool-submit-active for visual feedback during agent interaction.

nodes.label: Form Suitability Guidance
nodes.rationale: Avoid the Declarative API for highly dependent fields, custom UI components, and multi-step wizards.

nodes.label: toolautosubmit Usage
nodes.rationale: Auto-submit for read-only and low-risk actions; omit it for destructive or financial actions.

nodes.label: WebMCP Producer-Consumer
nodes.rationale: Pages register tools with document.modelContext.registerTool(); agents discover and execute them out-of-band; in-page agents use getTools() and executeTool().

nodes.label: Tool Registration Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: AbortSignal unregisters a tool; exposedTo grants cross-origin discovery via a mutual opt-in handshake.

nodes.label: Input Schema and Validation
nodes.rationale: inputSchema is JSON Schema; descriptions state what and when, never repeat types; the browser does not validate, so validate and apply defaults in execute.

nodes.label: Structured Error Returns
nodes.rationale: Return actionable error payloads as values; throw only when cancelled (signal.aborted).

nodes.label: Cancellation Contract
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY: honor the per-execution AbortSignal; pass it to fetch and clear timers in abort listeners.

nodes.label: Framework Integrations
nodes.rationale: React useWebMCP, Angular provideExperimentalWebMcpTools and Vue useWebMCP composable; tool definitions stay identical to the raw API.

nodes.label: Client-Side WebMCP
nodes.rationale: WebMCP runs entirely client-side in the browser tab; no HTTP, SSE or stdio transports.

nodes.label: WebMCP Best Practices
nodes.rationale: Specific verbs, positive descriptions, atomic and composable tools, dynamic registration, AbortSignal cleanup.

nodes.label: WebMCP Anti-Patterns
nodes.rationale: No backend transports, no Resources or Prompts, clear inputSchema descriptions, HTTPS only.

nodes.label: WebMCP Status
nodes.rationale: Early preview in Chromium 146.0.7672.0+, requires the chrome://flags/#enable-webmcp-testing flag.

nodes.label: Ponytail Lazy Mode
nodes.rationale: Smallest change that fully solves the task; lazy about the solution, never the change; the never-cut list covers validation, security, accessibility, data loss.

nodes.label: Smallest Complete Change
nodes.rationale: First option that fully works: does it need to exist? is it already in the codebase? standard library? installed dependency? one line? minimum code.

nodes.label: Ponytail Levels
nodes.rationale: Lite: build what was asked, name the smaller option; Full: the default rules; Ultra: also questions the request before building.

nodes.label: Repo Audit Protocol
nodes.rationale: Map first (README, config, entry points, tests, load), look for (bug, risk, scale, missing test, speed, lean), check before you report, then output in three ranked groups.

nodes.label: Audit Finding Categories
nodes.rationale: Bug, risk, scale, missing test, speed, lean; lean findings: delete, reuse, stdlib, yagni, merge, split.

nodes.label: Audit Output Format
nodes.rationale: What this repo does, findings in three groups with four-part entries, verdict, lean count, not-checked list.

nodes.label: Shortcut Debt Ledger
nodes.rationale: shortcut: markers with a ceiling and an upgrade trigger are collected into one ledger; markers without a trigger are flagged no-trigger as rot risk.

nodes.label: Ponytail Gain Scoreboard
nodes.rationale: Measured benchmark averages, not per-repo numbers: Lines of code -53%, Output tokens -45%, Cost -26%, Time -41%, hidden checks 97% and tests 98%.

nodes.label: Ponytail Help Reference
nodes.rationale: Levels table (lite, full, ultra), skills table, the level sticks until changed, deactivate via stop ponytail or off, band commands, config default mode, update flow.

nodes.label: Change Review Protocol
nodes.rationale: Read the diff and the code it touches, trace the real flow, look for bug, risk, scale, missing test, speed and lean findings; check before you report.

nodes.label: Review Finding Categories
nodes.rationale: Bug, risk, scale, missing test, speed, lean; every finding needs a concrete case.

nodes.label: Review Output Format
nodes.rationale: What this change does, findings in three groups, verdict, lean, not-checked.

nodes.label: Shared Platform Services
nodes.rationale: Messaging, identity, scheduling, realtime and audit are implemented once and consumed by every module (principle A1).

nodes.label: Identity & Consent
nodes.rationale: Messaging identity links, contact permissions, opt-outs and consent records; used by bubbles, Restore Product and Review.

nodes.label: Messaging Gateway
nodes.rationale: Inbound: webhook signature check, idempotent event store. Outbound: channel adapters, send-time eligibility, rate limits, bounded retries, one delivery log for all purposes.

nodes.label: Scheduler & Queue
nodes.rationale: Delayed jobs (review requests), batch sends (restock), retries, restock detection.

nodes.label: Realtime
nodes.rationale: Server-sent events per business for bubble.created, bubble.updated and bubble.removed; clients reconnect and refetch.

nodes.label: Audit Log
nodes.rationale: Batch approvals, exports, consent changes, identity links, role changes.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: One deployable API internally separated by module and service boundary; extract only on a measured need (principle A2).

nodes.label: Outbox Pattern
nodes.rationale: A business transaction and its outbound message row commit together; a separate dispatcher sends (principle A5).

nodes.label: Tenant Isolation
nodes.rationale: business_id injected at the middleware layer (A3); the repository guard rejects queries without it; RLS as defence in depth.

nodes.label: Eligibility Engine
nodes.rationale: Single send-time decision point shared by Restore Product, Review and the Consent flow; evaluated at preview and dispatch (RP-08).

nodes.label: AI Safety Architecture
nodes.rationale: Untrusted content only in delimited DATA blocks; static read-only tool registry; per-call tenant and role authz; schema-validated output; redaction (OD-10).

nodes.label: Data Classification
nodes.rationale: Public, Internal, Personal, Special and Secret handling tiers (section 5).

nodes.label: Backend First Strategy
nodes.rationale: Nothing is sent without a human decision; the frontend is built against a frozen API contract.

nodes.label: Phase 0 Feasibility
nodes.rationale: Blocking decisions OD-01, OD-05, OD-06, OD-11 closed; spike branches for risky integrations; go or no-go recorded.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Backend Foundation
nodes.rationale: Repo layout, FastAPI app, tenant guard, auth, RBAC; exit: tenant-isolation and idempotency tests pass.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Platform Services
nodes.rationale: Identity and Consent, Messaging Gateway, Scheduler, Realtime, Audit Log; exit: isolation and idempotency tests per service.

nodes.label: Phase 3 Customer Genome
nodes.rationale: Adapter, history, Repeat Buyers, bubbles, Restore Product; exit: CG-T01 to T08 and RP-T01 to T08 pass.

nodes.label: Phase 4 Creator Commerce
nodes.rationale: Review, consent, cards, export; ads and collaboration deferred behind OD-06 feasibility.

nodes.label: Phase 5 Agent Workspace
nodes.rationale: FAQ registry, chat routing, read-only tools, usage metering, tour; exit: AW-T01 to T10 pass.

nodes.label: Phase 6 Frontend
nodes.rationale: Release 1 app shell plus Customer Genome, Review and Agent Workspace screens over the frozen API; deferred screens blocked, not mocked.

nodes.label: Phase 7 Hardening and Release
nodes.rationale: Security review, cross-tenant suite, load, failure, CI, staged rollout; Definition of Done met.

nodes.label: Risk Register
nodes.rationale: R1 to R9 risks with likelihood, impact and mitigation; OD-06, OD-05 and Meta app review lead time are the top risks.

nodes.label: Working Agreement
nodes.rationale: Definition of ready and done; two never-relaxed rules: a feature is not done if it sends without human confirmation, or shows a value it does not know.

nodes.label: Wise Brand Palette
nodes.rationale: Lime-green primary #9fe870 as the universal CTA accent; sage canvas #e8ebe6; near-black ink #0e0f0c with olive warmth; full semantic palette with hover and active variants.

nodes.label: Display Typography
nodes.rationale: Wise Sans weight 900 for hero headlines up to 126px; Inter weight 600 for sub-displays and body; Wise Sans never lighter than 900 on marketing surfaces.

nodes.label: 24px Pill Radius System
nodes.rationale: Cards and buttons are pill-rounded at the brand signature 24px radius; sharp corners are never used.

nodes.label: Band Elevation System
nodes.rationale: Sage canvas elevation: white cards cycle on the sage band; surface contrast is the primary elevation cue.

nodes.label: Signature Components
nodes.rationale: Hero band, currency-converter card, badges, nav, footer, content bands; Do's and Don'ts: single accent, no second accent, no sharp CTAs.

nodes.rationale: Run unit and integration suites plus the frontend production build; apply Alembic migrations in the expand step; deploy internal, then 5%, 25%, 100% while watching error rate, queue age and outbound failure rate.

nodes.label: Incident Response
nodes.rationale: Provider outage: leave outbox rows pending; duplicate event: inspect the unique inbound key and do not manually resend; tenant isolation alert: stop traffic to the affected endpoint and preserve audit logs; stale data: show the unavailable state and never backfill a guessed value.

nodes.label: Secrets Handling
nodes.rationale: Provider tokens and JWT secrets are environment-managed; never print authorization headers, access tokens or provider credentials in logs or support output.

nodes.label: Product Vision
nodes.rationale: Helps a business know its customers, market with evidence and get unstuck quickly; three modules share one dashboard, one customer identity layer and one messaging layer.

nodes.label: Product Principles
nodes.rationale: P1 No fabricated data; P2 Human sends, system prepares; P3 AI is a last resort; P4 Consent is a gate; P5 Tenant isolation is absolute; P6 Least data to AI; P7 Untrusted input stays untrusted.

nodes.label: Customer Genome Module
nodes.rationale: Turns order history into customer understanding; surfaces returning buyers the moment they message, and wins back customers waiting for out-of-stock products. IDs CG-01 to CG-11 and RP-01 to RP-10.

nodes.label: Creator Commerce Module
nodes.rationale: Collects customer reviews, studies competitor ads, tracks own ads and finds collaborators; optional Influencer Suggestions. IDs RV-01 to RV-13, MI-01 to MI-05, MP-01 to MP-04, CF-01 to CF-03, IF-01 to IF-02.

nodes.label: Agent Workspace Module
nodes.rationale: Answers common questions instantly at zero AI cost; uses AI only for unique questions; guides new users with a tour. IDs AW-01 to AW-11.

nodes.label: Staging Preconditions
nodes.rationale: Staging Postgres, Redis, worker, API and frontend URLs; injected secrets; disposable staging tenant and Owner/Admin/Staff accounts; sandbox provider adapters; backups confirmed.

nodes.label: Migration and Rollback
nodes.rationale: Record migration revision and backup ID; run alembic upgrade head; run smoke and contract checks; verify expand/contract rollback on a disposable copy; no rollback while dependent code is live.

nodes.label: Load and Failure Tests
nodes.rationale: Burst webhook traffic and verify bubble p95 of 5 seconds or less; concurrent restock previews and confirmations with idempotency and no duplicate sends; concurrent chat requests with tenant and user isolation; worker stop during a batch with no duplicate sends; provider outage with bounded retries and visible attempts; Redis restart with SSE reconnect and REST state refresh; database failover with no lost events.

nodes.label: Accessibility and Browser Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Lighthouse against login, dashboard, repeat buyers, reviews, chat and tour with accessibility score at least 95; keyboard-only pass over navigation, forms, tables, bubble actions, chat and tour; unknown values show Unavailable, never blank or fabricated zeroes.

nodes.label: Owner Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Owner signs up and reaches the workspace; confirms a restore-product batch after reviewing recipients and skip reasons; configures review settings and verifies consent-gated export; staff can use read-only chat but not Owner/Admin actions; owner verifies customer bubbles never expose unresolved identity figures; owner signs off the Release 1 scope and deferred ads scope.

nodes.label: Rollout Phases
nodes.rationale: Deploy to internal traffic and watch error rate, queue age, SSE disconnects and outbound failures; expand to 5%, then 25%, then 100% when the previous stage is stable; roll back application code on breach; retain expand migrations until old code is removed; record the release, migration, smoke and owner-acceptance evidence.
